compositions.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop website design comp for Kentcrosswise, edge-to-edge at a landscape 1440x1000 viewport. This is a real homepage interface, not a poster, presentation, browser mockup or photograph of a screen. Kentcrosswise is a personal hub built with AI agents. Visitors should enter a clearly simulated demonstration of contacts, mood and social snapshots.
The owner-approved visual world is a calm, richly rendered grassy hill and warm beige original retro CRT computer beneath an expansive blue sky moving toward dusk, a few drifting firefly lights, delicate white serif navigation, tactile natural grass and cinematic warm light. No logos on the computer, no borrowed artist branding. This first composition is landscape-led: the environment is the page's continuous ground and the single computer feels discoverable within it. Use the site's working navigation, headline and action as crisp interface parts integrated into the space, with unmistakable reading order and strong contrast. Name the site “Kentcrosswise”. Navigation: “Home”, “Demo”, “Office”, “Sign in”. Main copy: “A small place for everyday life.” Supporting copy: “Explore a simulated hub for people, moods, and the things you follow.” Primary button: “Explore the demo”. Secondary link: “Visit the agent office”. Include a discreet functional day/night control. The lower edge should begin a legible next section, “A glimpse inside”, rather than a row of marketing cards. Make the scene beautiful and fully dimensional, typography refined, layout spacious but purposeful. No metric hero, badges, gradients on text or invented personal claims.

Create a high-fidelity desktop website design comp for Kentcrosswise, edge-to-edge at a landscape 1440x1000 viewport, crisp readable actual UI. No browser frame or external device framing. Kentcrosswise is a personal hub built with AI agents; the visitor's primary action is to explore a simulated hub of contacts, moods and social snapshots.
Hold this approved visual world: lush grass, blue-to-dusk sky, firefly lights, warm original beige retro computer, delicate serif lettering, natural texture and quiet cinematic nostalgia. This second composition goes further in using that world: the computer itself is the large, dominant gateway into the site, a sculptural dimensional object within the grassy scene. Its screen carries a genuine interface with the prominent action “Explore the demo”, while the surrounding site remains readable and navigable. Do not make a generic split hero with copy beside a product. Let the geometry of the single computer and the environment structure the page. The computer is original unbranded artwork, never an Apple logo or copied hardware photograph.
Name: “Kentcrosswise”. Shared navigation: “Home”, “Demo”, “Office”, “Sign in”. Supporting line: “A personal hub, built with a small team of AI agents.” Screen text can include “Welcome in.” and the primary button. A secondary “Agent office” link and a subtle day/night control must be findable. Finish the visible viewport as a designed website, with the beginning of a calm explanatory area below. No equal-sized feature cards, fake testimonials, dashboard metrics used as marketing proof, or invented personal biography. Strive for a memorable, warm, highly crafted and plausible responsive web experience.

Create a high-fidelity desktop website design comp for Kentcrosswise at a landscape 1440x1000 viewport, edge-to-edge with crisp readable UI, no browser frame. It is the public entrance to a personal hub built with AI agents, with a simulated demo rather than private user data. The primary visitor action is “Explore the demo”.
Use the owner-approved world of a lush grassy hill, blue twilight sky, warm beige original unbranded retro computer, drifting luminous particles and delicate serif site lettering. This third composition is the boldest functional translation: a large, carefully crafted open hub window is the main working surface floating within the landscape, so visitors see a glimpse of the actual product immediately. The small physical computer remains a single supporting sculptural object in the same scene; do not repeat it. The window is part of the webpage, not a browser or a device mockup. Make the interface warmly tactile and very readable, integrated into the same palette rather than generic white cards.
Site name “Kentcrosswise”. Navigation: “Home”, “Demo”, “Office”, “Sign in”. Main line: “A little space for your everyday.” Label the sample visibly “Simulated data”. Within the open hub show a natural information layout: “People” with Ivo Merriweather, Sol Ashdown and Dev Juniper; a “Mood” view with happiness 0.29 and stress 0.91; and “Following” with YouTube 5,120, Instagram 4,709, TikTok 3,946. Use a true data/chart/list composition, not equal marketing feature cards. Include a prominent “Explore the demo” control, an “Agent office” link and a small day/night control. Keep all text readable and claims factual; no prices, testimonials or invented biography.
